title: Negotiable instrument act processing failed
description: Emitted as the negotiable_instrument_act_processed_failure event type once per request when an asynchronous create (CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT), update (UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT) or termination (DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT) requested through the negotiable instrument act API is rejected by a business rule, and also by the instrument act callback flow when a created act is rejected after the maximum number of attempts to link it to digital receivables. Consumers can use error_code and error_details to tell the client why the operation was not applied.

requester_document_number.title: Requester document number
requester_document_number.description: Unformatted CPF (11 digits) or CNPJ (14 digits) of the participant that requested the operation, taken from the request. Omitted in failures produced by the instrument act callback flow.

negotiable_instrument_act_id.title: Negotiable instrument act ID
negotiable_instrument_act_id.description: Client-provided identifier of the negotiable instrument act targeted by the failed operation, up to 45 characters.

operation_number.title: Operation number
operation_number.description: Client-provided operation identification code of the act, up to 36 characters, assigned by the signatory responsible for controlling the negotiable instrument act.

feature_type.title: Feature type
feature_type.description: Operation group that failed, serialized from the FeatureType enum. CREATE_CONTRACT: contract creation (not used by this event). UPDATE_CONTRACT: contract update (not used by this event). DELETE_CONTRACT: contract deletion (not used by this event). CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: negotiable instrument act creation. UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: negotiable instrument act update. DELETE_INSTRUMENT_ACT: negotiable instrument act termination.

operation_type.title: Operation type
operation_type.description: Detailed operation that failed, serialized from the OperationType enum. CREATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT for creation; UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT_INCL, UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT_ALTE or UPDATE_INSTRUMENT_ACT_EXCL for an inclusion, alteration or exclusion update; CANCELLATION_ERROR, CLOSING_ENEP, CLOSING_ENEM, CLOSING_ENES or CLOSING_DJUD for a termination, mapped from the termination reason CNOP, ENEP, ENEM, ENES or DJUD.

error_code.title: Error code
error_code.description: Legacy business error code returned by the API that explains why the operation failed, as listed in the producer StatusCodeError enum. For example, 114103 means an act with this negotiable_instrument_act_id already exists, 114111 means the act was not found and 114123 means the act was rejected by the callback flow.

error_details.title: Error details
error_details.description: Error in the new error dictionary format, with a 6-digit code and a human-readable description. Omitted when the legacy error_code has no mapping to the new dictionary.

code.title: Error code (new format)
code.description: Business error code from the new error dictionary, 6 digits following [MM][O][nnn] (module, operation and sequence). For example, 121094 means the act already exists, 125001 means it was not found and 123002 means it was rejected.

description.title: Error description
description.description: Human-readable message that explains the error code; it can change over time and must not be used as a technical key.
examples: there's already a negotiable instrument act registered with this negotiable_instrument_act_id
